title: Fake account password reset
subject: Unusual sign-in activity detected
body:
Hi,

We detected unusual sign-in activity. Verify within 24 hours:

https://micros0ft-support.invalid/verify
safeAction: Open the official portal from a saved bookmark and review recent sign-ins.

title: University IT maintenance notice
subject: Planned maintenance window tonight
body:
Hello,

Authentication maintenance is planned tonight from 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
Contact the IT Help Desk through the campus portal if issues continue.
indicators: Expected institutional domain and calm tone
safeAction: Confirm maintenance through the university portal or status page.

title: Package delivery scam
subject: Delivery failed: action required
body:
We could not complete delivery. Confirm your address and pay the re-delivery fee:

http://ups-tracking-secure.invalid/update-address
safeAction: Open the carrier's official app and look up the tracking number there.

title: Informational bank alert
subject: New device sign-in detected
body:
We noticed a sign-in from a new device. If this was you, no action is needed.
Otherwise, open your banking app. We never ask for your password by email.
indicators: Directs you to the official app
safeAction: Open the bank's official app directly and review account activity.

title: Payroll direct-deposit change
subject: Direct deposit verification required
body:
Your next paycheck is on hold because your banking details could not be verified.
Confirm your routing number and account information before 3:00 PM:

https://employee-payments.invalid/direct-deposit
safeAction: Contact payroll using the number in the employee directory, not the message.

title: Routine benefits enrollment reminder
subject: Open enrollment closes Friday
body:
Open enrollment closes Friday at 5:00 PM. Review your current elections in the
employee portal. If you need help, attend Thursday's benefits Q&A or contact the
People Team through the company directory.
indicators: Directs employees to the known internal portal
Does not request information by email
safeAction: Navigate to the employee portal from the company intranet to review benefits.

title: Unexpected shared document
subject: A confidential document was shared with you
body:
A confidential document has been shared with your account.

Sign in to view it before access expires:
https://cloud-docs-notice.invalid/shared/quarterly-review
indicators: Requests a sign-in after an unexpected share
safeAction: Open the organization's approved document service directly and check shared files.

title: Security team MFA notice
subject: Multiple sign-in prompts reported
body:
We are investigating reports of unexpected sign-in approval prompts.
Do not approve a prompt you did not initiate. Report unexpected prompts with the
Security button in the company portal. No reply to this message is required.
indicators: Provides preventive guidance without requesting approval
Directs reports through a known internal channel
Does not include a sign-in link
safeAction: Reject unexpected prompts and report them through the official security channel.

title: Executive gift-card request
subject: Need a quick favor before my meeting
body:
I'm heading into a meeting and need you to purchase six gift cards for a client.
Send the card numbers and PINs by replying to this email. Please keep this between us.

I need them within the hour.

—Jordan
https://executive-mail.invalid/request
indicators: Unusual financial request from an executive
Sender address does not use the company domain
safeAction: Verify the request with the executive through a known phone number or assistant.

title: Completed expense report receipt
subject: Expense report ER-1042 approved
body:
Expense report ER-1042 has been approved. The reimbursement will appear in your
next scheduled payment. You can view the report from the Expenses section of the
employee portal. No action is required.
indicators: Does not request payment or credentials
Directs the user to the known employee portal
safeAction: If the report is unfamiliar, verify it from the employee portal without using email links.

title: Fake calendar cancellation
subject: Interview canceled — review new time
body:
Your interview has been canceled. The organizer proposed a new confidential time.
Sign in immediately to keep your interview slot:

https://meeting-tools.invalid/reschedule
indicators: Pressures the recipient to sign in immediately
safeAction: Check the original calendar event or contact the recruiter using prior correspondence.

title: Vendor maintenance confirmation
subject: Maintenance completed successfully
body:
Scheduled maintenance completed at 02:15 UTC. All systems are operating normally.
No customer action is required. Current service status remains available from the
status page bookmarked in your administrator console.
indicators: Informational message with no requested action
References a known status page rather than embedding a link
safeAction: Confirm service status from the administrator console if operational impact is suspected.

title: QR code to view a shared document
subject: Scan the QR code to open the visitor sign-in form
body:
A new visitor sign-in form is available. Scan the QR code posted in the lobby to open it:

https://office-qr.invalid/visitor-signin
indicators: QR code hides the real destination until scanned
Unexpected sign-in form from a lobby poster
Sender domain does not match the company domain
safeAction: Open the visitor sign-in form from the company intranet instead of scanning a posted code.

title: Flood of sign-in approval prompts
subject: Approve the sign-in prompt to keep your account active
body:
We sent several sign-in approval prompts to your phone. Approve one now or reply with the 6-digit code from the prompt to confirm it was you:

https://company-support.invalid/approve-signin
indicators: Repeated approval prompts you did not start
Asks for the one-time code from an approval prompt
Pressure to approve quickly to keep the account active
Sender domain does not match the company domain
safeAction: Do not approve prompts you did not start. Report unexpected prompts through the official security channel.

title: Overdue vendor invoice with new bank details
subject: Invoice INV-8842 overdue: updated payment details
body:
Invoice INV-8842 is overdue. We changed banks, so send payment to the new account below and confirm here:

https://vendor-payments.invalid/pay-invoice
indicators: Bank details changed without prior notice
Payment link on an unfamiliar domain
No purchase order or prior invoice reference you recognize
safeAction: Verify the invoice and bank details with the vendor using a known phone number from prior invoices.

title: Job offer with an equipment fee
subject: You are selected: pay the equipment deposit to start
body:
Congratulations, you were selected for the remote support role. Pay a $250 equipment deposit to receive your laptop and start Monday:

https://careers-fast.invalid/onboarding
indicators: Requests payment before starting a job
Generic role description and rushed start date
Sender domain does not match any known employer
safeAction: Verify the offer through the employer's official careers page and never pay to start a job.

title: Urgent charity donation appeal
subject: Donate now: families need help tonight
body:
Families affected by the storm need help tonight. Donate now with a card through our emergency appeal:

https://relief-fund.invalid/donate-now
indicators: Donation link on an unfamiliar domain
No registered charity name or registration number
safeAction: Donate only through a charity you already know, reached from its official site.

title: Library due-date reminder
subject: Two items due back Friday
body:
Hello,

Two borrowed items are due back Friday. Renew them from your library account on the university portal or return them to the front desk.
indicators: Directs you to the known university portal
Expected institutional domain and calm tone
safeAction: Renew the items from your library account on the university portal.

title: Pay stub ready in the employee portal
subject: Your latest pay stub is ready
body:
Hello,

Your latest pay stub is ready. View it in the Payroll section of the employee portal. No action is required.
indicators: Does not request payment or credentials
Directs you to the known employee portal
safeAction: Open the employee portal from the company intranet to view the pay stub.

title: Managed software update available
subject: Software update available on your work laptop
body:
Hello,

A software update is available for your work laptop. Install it from the managed Software Center app when ready. No sign-in link is needed.
indicators: Directs you to the managed Software Center app
Does not include a sign-in link
safeAction: Install the update from the managed Software Center app on your laptop.

title: Conference registration confirmation
subject: Registration confirmed: CONF-2210
body:
Hello,

Your conference registration is confirmed (CONF-2210). View your ticket and schedule from the conference site you registered on. No action is required.
indicators: Does not request payment or credentials
Directs you to the site you registered on
safeAction: If the registration is unfamiliar, check it from the conference site you used.

title: Bank scheduled maintenance notice
subject: Scheduled maintenance Sunday 2:00-4:00 AM
body:
Hello,

Online banking will be unavailable Sunday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM for scheduled maintenance. No action is required. We never ask for your password by email.
indicators: Informational message with no requested action
safeAction: Plan around the maintenance window; confirm it from the bank's official app if needed.
